scope: Native cancellation primitive; cancellable language-task JIT remains disabled. Timings are debug process totals with startup/compilation and concurrent work, not release acceptance.
implementation: Immutable compiler cancellation policy controls loop-safepoint emission. All four translator construction paths inherit it; VM initializes it from the task token before compilation. Context token is borrowed from the enclosing live task. Earlier errors are preserved.

validation.native_cancellation_test: Bounded child process runs compiled loop, function and direct-argument code; tests cancellation errors, balanced depth/roots, prior-error preservation and successful subsequent entry.

rejected_unconditional_safepoints.status: Uncommitted intermediate candidate; rejected after all seven local elapsed pairs slowed down. Raw binary identity retained; not a released runtime.

evidence.scope: Seven alternating debug process-total pairs; 101 calls of a 20000-iteration scalar kernel. Includes startup/JIT compilation; concurrent production and tests, not release performance acceptance.
